title: Prophet Nuh and the Big Ship
prophet: Prophet Nuh (Noah), peace be upon him

scenes.text: Long ago, Allah sent Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, to his people. He asked them to worship Allah alone and to stop doing wrong.
Allah told Prophet Nuh to build a big ship. Allah was watching over him and showing him what to do.
When the time came, Prophet Nuh brought onto the ship two of every kind of animal, a pair of each, together with the people who believed.
Prophet Nuh began the journey with the name of Allah. The ship sailed on huge waves, as tall as mountains.
Then Allah told the earth to swallow its water and the sky to stop the rain. The water went down, and the ship came to rest on Mount Judi.

lesson: Allah takes care of those who believe in Him and do what He asks.

verse.intro: Prophet Nuh started the journey in the name of Allah.

title: Prophet Sulaiman and the Little Ant
prophet: Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon), peace be upon him

scenes.text: Allah gave Prophet Sulaiman, peace be upon him, many gifts. He was even taught to understand the language of the birds.
One day, Prophet Sulaiman's great army set off in neat rows, with birds flying along too.
When they reached the Valley of the Ants, a little ant called out: "O ants, go into your homes, so that Sulaiman and his army do not step on you without knowing!"
Prophet Sulaiman heard the little ant and smiled. He thanked Allah for His gifts and asked Allah to help him do good.

lesson: Even a tiny ant cares for others. Prophet Sulaiman listened kindly and thanked Allah.

verse.intro: Prophet Sulaiman thanked Allah with this dua.

title: Prophet Yunus and the Big Fish
prophet: Prophet Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him

scenes.text: Allah sent Prophet Yunus, peace be upon him, to teach his people.
One day, Prophet Yunus left his town and got onto a ship full of people and things.
Then a huge fish swallowed him!
In the darkness, Prophet Yunus called out to Allah: "There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have done wrong."
Allah heard his dua. Prophet Yunus was placed on an open shore, tired and weak, and Allah made a gourd plant grow over him.
Then Allah sent Prophet Yunus to a hundred thousand people or more, and they believed.

lesson: We can always call on Allah, even when things are hard. Allah hears us.

verse.intro: This is the dua Prophet Yunus made in the darkness.

title: Baby Musa and the River
prophet: Prophet Musa (Moses), peace be upon him

scenes.text: Allah inspired the mother of baby Musa, peace be upon him: when she was afraid for him, she should place him in the river and not be afraid or sad. Allah promised to bring him back to her.
So she put baby Musa in a wooden chest and placed it in the river. The river carried the chest to the bank.
The family of Pharaoh picked him up. Pharaoh's wife said: "He will be a joy for me and for you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will be useful to us, or we may take him as a son."
Musa's sister followed him from far away. Baby Musa would not feed from any nurse, so his sister said: "Shall I show you a family who will look after him for you?"
So Allah brought Musa back to his mother, so that she would be happy and not sad, and would know that Allah's promise is true.

lesson: Allah always keeps His promise. We can trust Allah when we are worried.

verse.intro: Allah tells us how He brought Musa back to his mother.

title: Building the Kaaba
prophet: Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and Prophet Ismail (Ishmael), peace be upon them

scenes.text: Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him, settled some of his family in a valley in Makkah, where nothing could be farmed, near Allah's sacred House. He asked Allah to provide for them.
Later, Prophet Ibrahim and his son Prophet Ismail, peace be upon them, raised the foundations of the House, the Kaaba.
As they worked, they made dua: "Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing."
Allah made the House a place people return to and a place of safety. He asked Prophet Ibrahim and Prophet Ismail to keep it clean for those who come to pray.

lesson: When we do something good, we ask Allah to accept it from us.

verse.intro: This is the dua Prophet Ibrahim and Prophet Ismail made while building.

title: Prophet Adam, the First Person
prophet: Prophet Adam, peace be upon him

scenes.text: Allah told the angels that He would place a khalifah, someone to look after things, on the earth.
Allah taught Prophet Adam, peace be upon him, the names of all things.
Allah told the angels to bow down to Adam. They all did, except Iblis, who was too proud.
Prophet Adam and his wife lived in the Garden and could eat from it freely. But Allah told them not to go near one tree.
Shaytan tricked them into going near the tree. So they left the Garden and came to live on the earth.
Prophet Adam and his wife were sorry and asked Allah to forgive them. Allah accepted their repentance. He is the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.

lesson: When we make a mistake, we say sorry to Allah. Allah forgives those who are truly sorry.

verse.intro: This is the dua Prophet Adam and his wife made.
